difficulty_and_token_rules.difficulty_percentile: rank within language; hardest=100, easiest=0; solve-rate ties use task_id
difficulty_and_token_rules.secondary_selection_metric: maximum median (n_input_tokens + n_output_tokens) over valid non-target mini-swe-agent rollouts

method.optional_extension_rule: take the second token-ranked eligible task in every language/stratum cell; if a cell has no second distinct task, fill the remaining optional slots from all still-unselected hard/medium-eligible tasks by descending median historical total tokens with stable identifiers as tie-breakers
